from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from benchmark_reference_pdf_effect import main, run_benchmark, summarize


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROTOCOL = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/research-gap-enhancement-effects/pdf-native-v1.json"
DRIFT_PROTOCOL = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/research-gap-enhancement-effects/pdf-native-v1-parser-drift.json"
COMMITTED = ROOT / "references/research-gap-enhancement-effects/pdf-native-v1"


class ReferencePdfEffectBenchmarkTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_protocol_is_frozen_and_limits_claim_scope(self) -> None:
        protocol = json.loads(PROTOCOL.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(protocol["status"], "frozen")
        self.assertEqual(protocol["parser"], {"name": "pypdf", "version": "6.16.2"})
        self.assertEqual(protocol["gates"]["real_ocr_calls"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(protocol["gates"]["web_implementation_status"], "not-implemented")
        drift = json.loads(DRIFT_PROTOCOL.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(drift["parser"], {"name": "pypdf", "version": "6.16.2-drift"})
        self.assertTrue(drift["gates"]["parser_identity_matches_protocol"])

    def test_committed_result_stays_frozen_and_current_source_drift_is_explicit(self) -> None:
        git = os.environ.get("CKB_GIT", "git")
        raw, report = run_benchmark(PROTOCOL, git)
        self.assertEqual(report, summarize(raw))
        expected_raw = json.loads((COMMITTED / "raw-results.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        expected_report = json.loads((COMMITTED / "report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(expected_report, summarize(expected_raw))
        self.assertEqual(expected_report["status"], "passed")
        self.assertFalse(report["checks"]["current_implementation_matches_snapshot"])
        self.assertEqual(report["status"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(report["metrics"], expected_report["metrics"])
        self.assertEqual(
            report["parser_identity"]["actual"],
            {
                "module_name": "pypdf",
                "module_version": "6.16.2",
                "distribution_name": "pypdf",
                "distribution_version": "6.16.2",
            },
        )
        self.assertTrue(report["checks"]["parser_identity_matches_protocol"])
        self.assertEqual(expected_report["effect"]["native_pdf"], "已证实增强")
        self.assertEqual(report["effect"]["pdf_web_ocr_combined_gap"], "证据不足")

    def test_parser_version_drift_fails_without_overwriting_existing_results(self) -> None:
        git = os.environ.get("CKB_GIT", "git")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ckb-pdf-effect-drift-") as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            raw = root / "raw-results.json"
            report = root / "report.json"
            raw.write_bytes(b"original-raw\n")
            report.write_bytes(b"original-report\n")
            output = io.StringIO()
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
                exit_status = main(
                    [
                        "--protocol",
                        str(DRIFT_PROTOCOL),
                        "--raw",
                        str(raw),
                        "--report",
                        str(report),
                        "--git",
                        git,
                    ]
                )
            result = json.loads(output.getvalue())
            self.assertEqual(exit_status, 1)
            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "failed")
            self.assertFalse(result["written"])
            self.assertEqual(
                result["failed_checks"],
                [
                    "current_implementation_matches_snapshot",
                    "parser_identity_matches_protocol",
                    "web_implementation_status",
                ],
            )
            self.assertEqual(result["parser_identity"]["expected"]["version"], "6.16.2-drift")
            self.assertEqual(result["parser_identity"]["actual"]["distribution_version"], "6.16.2")
            self.assertEqual(raw.read_bytes(), b"original-raw\n")
            self.assertEqual(report.read_bytes(), b"original-report\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

from benchmark_reference_pdf_ocr_fidelity import run_benchmark


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROTOCOL = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/research-gap-enhancement-effects/pdf-ocr-code-table-fidelity-v1.json"
FIXTURES = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/reference-pdf-ocr"
COMMITTED = ROOT / "references/research-gap-enhancement-effects/pdf-ocr-code-table-fidelity-v1"


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


class ReferencePdfOcrFidelityBenchmarkTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_frozen_protocol_binds_distinct_native_scanned_and_hybrid_fixtures(self) -> None:
        protocol = json.loads(PROTOCOL.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        ground_truth_path = ROOT / protocol["fixture_manifest"]
        ground_truth = json.loads(ground_truth_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(protocol["status"], "frozen")
        self.assertEqual(_sha256(ground_truth_path), protocol["fixture_manifest_sha256"])
        self.assertEqual(ground_truth["kind_evidence"]["native_text_pages"], [True, True])
        self.assertEqual(ground_truth["kind_evidence"]["scanned_text_pages"], [False, False])
        self.assertEqual(ground_truth["kind_evidence"]["hybrid_text_pages"], [True, False])
        for name, document in ground_truth["documents"].items():
            self.assertEqual(_sha256(FIXTURES / document["path"]), protocol["fixture_sha256"][name])
        self.assertTrue(ground_truth["noise"]["repeated_header"])
        self.assertTrue(ground_truth["noise"]["footer_page_number"])
        self.assertEqual(
            ground_truth["quality_dimensions"],
            ["text_coverage", "code_fidelity", "table_structure", "source_page_locator"],
        )

    def test_committed_measurement_reports_each_quality_dimension_separately(self) -> None:
        report = json.loads((COMMITTED / "report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        metrics = report["metrics"]
        self.assertEqual(report["status"], "measured")
        self.assertNotIn("pass_rate", report)
        self.assertNotIn("overall_accuracy", report)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["text_coverage"]["recall"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["text_coverage"]["matched_items"], 23)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["code_fidelity"]["exact_line_recall"], 0.666667)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["code_fidelity"]["symbol_sequence_accuracy"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["code_fidelity"]["indentation_accuracy"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["table_structure"]["cell_recall"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["table_structure"]["row_alignment_accuracy"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["table_structure"]["column_order_accuracy"], 1.0)
        self.assertTrue(metrics["table_structure"]["wrapped_cell_continuation"])
        self.assertTrue(metrics["table_structure"]["table_fragment_detected"])
        self.assertEqual(metrics["source_page_locator"]["accuracy"], 1.0)
        self.assertTrue(metrics["source_page_locator"]["hybrid_methods_match"])
        self.assertEqual(report["quality_gate_failures"], [])
        self.assertTrue(all(report["quality_gate_evaluations"].values()))

    def test_committed_measurement_proves_real_ocr_content_and_reopened_provenance(self) -> None:
        raw = json.loads((COMMITTED / "raw-results.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(raw["runtime"]["rapidocr_onnxruntime"], "1.4.4")
        self.assertEqual(raw["runtime"]["onnxruntime"], "1.29.0")
        self.assertEqual([page["method"] for page in raw["ingests"]["native"]["pages"]], ["native", "native"])
        self.assertEqual([page["method"] for page in raw["ingests"]["scanned"]["pages"]], ["ocr", "ocr"])
        self.assertEqual([page["method"] for page in raw["ingests"]["hybrid"]["pages"]], ["native", "ocr"])
        for name in ("native", "scanned", "hybrid"):
            checks = raw["ingest_checks"][name]
            self.assertTrue(checks["source_copy_exact"])
            self.assertTrue(checks["audit_passed"])
            self.assertTrue(checks["methods_match"])
        for page in raw["ingests"]["scanned"]["pages"]:
            self.assertEqual(page["ocr"]["metadata"]["engine"]["name"], "rapidocr_onnxruntime")
            self.assertEqual(page["ocr"]["metadata"]["engine"]["version"], "1.4.4")
            self.assertEqual(len(page["ocr"]["output_sha256"]), 64)
            self.assertIn("扫描" if page["page_number"] == 1 else "跨行表格", page["text"])

    def test_failure_matrix_covers_tool_timeout_empty_limit_and_corruption(self) -> None:
        report = json.loads((COMMITTED / "report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        diagnostics = {item["case"]: item for item in report["diagnostics"]}
        self.assertEqual(
            set(diagnostics),
            {"ocr-tool-missing", "ocr-timeout", "ocr-empty-output", "ocr-page-limit", "corrupt-pdf"},
        )
        self.assertTrue(all(item["matched"] for item in diagnostics.values()))
        self.assertIn("ocr-tool-missing: rapidocr_onnxruntime", diagnostics["ocr-tool-missing"]["stderr"])
        self.assertEqual(diagnostics["ocr-timeout"]["observed_reason"], "ocr-timeout")
        self.assertEqual(
            diagnostics["ocr-empty-output"]["observed_reason"],
            "ocr-text-below-usable-threshold",
        )
        self.assertEqual(diagnostics["ocr-page-limit"]["attempted_pages"], 1)
        self.assertIn("corrupt or unsupported PDF source", diagnostics["corrupt-pdf"]["observed_reason"])

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.environ.get("CKB_RUN_REAL_OCR_BENCHMARK") == "1", "real OCR replay is opt-in")
    def test_live_real_ocr_replay_meets_frozen_gates(self) -> None:
        raw, report = run_benchmark(PROTOCOL)

        self.assertEqual(report["quality_gate_failures"], [])
        self.assertEqual(raw["diagnostic_checks"], {name: True for name in [
            "ocr-tool-missing", "ocr-timeout", "ocr-empty-output", "ocr-page-limit", "corrupt-pdf"
        ]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

def test_static_ingest_review_drift_duplicate_audit_and_rollback(self) -> None:
        output = self._completed_output()
        snapshot = self.root / "snapshot.html"
        snapshot.write_text(HTML, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

        ingested = self._static_ingest(output, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(ingested.returncode, 4, ingested.stderr)
        result = json.loads(ingested.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "pending-agent-review")
        self.assertEqual(result["acquisition_mode"], "provided-static-snapshot")
        self.assertEqual(result["final_url"], "https://example.test/article")
        self.assertFalse((output / "human/references/网页快照资料.md").exists())

        manifest = json.loads(Path(result["manifest"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        extraction = json.loads(Path(manifest["extraction_file"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(manifest["input_adapter"], "web-snapshot-v1")
        self.assertEqual(manifest["source_sha256"], result["raw_snapshot_sha256"])
        self.assertEqual(manifest["body_snapshot_sha256"], result["body_snapshot_sha256"])
        self.assertEqual(manifest["web_capture"]["response_headers"]["etag"], ['"fixture-v1"'])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(extraction["excluded_regions"]), 4)

        repeated = self._static_ingest(output, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(repeated.returncode, 4, repeated.stderr)
        repeated_result = json.loads(repeated.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(repeated_result["idempotent"])
        self.assertEqual(repeated_result["reference_id"], result["reference_id"])

        review = json.loads(Path(result["review_template"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        paragraph = next(item for item in extraction["fragments"] if item["structure"] == "p")
        start = paragraph["source_range"]["start_line"]
        end = paragraph["source_range"]["end_line"]
        archived_lines = Path(result["source"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        review.update(
            {
                "status": "agent-reviewed",
                "summary_zh": "该网页快照记录许可可追溯的静态正文，并保留精确来源行范围。",
                "claims": [
                    {
                        "claim_zh": "归档正文明确说明结论可以通过 HTML 行范围复核。",
                        "fragment_id": paragraph["fragment_id"],
                        "start_line": start,
                        "end_line": end,
                        "source_text": "\n".join(archived_lines[start - 1 : end]),
                        "evidence_note": "已重新打开归档 HTML，并核对正文片段及其精确行范围。",
                    }
                ],
            }
        )
        review_path = self.root / "web-review.json"
        review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        reviewed = invoke("reference", "review", "--out", str(output), "--review", str(review_path))
        self.assertEqual(reviewed.returncode, 0, reviewed.stderr)
        human = output / "human/references/网页快照资料.md"
        human_text = human.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("[最终 URL](https://example.test/article)", human_text)
        self.assertIn(f"原文第 {start} 行", human_text)
        self.assertIn("获取时间：2026-09-05T01:02:03Z", human_text)

        connection = sqlite3.connect(output / "machine/knowledge.sqlite")
        try:
            indexed = "\n".join(row[0] for row in connection.execute(
                "SELECT content FROM sections WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY start_line",
                (f"reference:{result['reference_id']}",),
            ))
        finally:
            connection.close()
        self.assertIn("正文结论可由归档 HTML", indexed)
        self.assertNotIn("导航噪声", indexed)
        self.assertNotIn("window.secret", indexed)

        drifted = self.root / "snapshot-drifted.html"
        drifted.write_text(HTML.replace("正文结论", "漂移后的正文结论"), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        rejected_drift = self._static_ingest(output, drifted)
        self.assertEqual(rejected_drift.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("snapshot drift detected", rejected_drift.stderr)
        revision = self._static_ingest(output, drifted, "--revision-of", result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(revision.returncode, 4, revision.stderr)
        revision_result = json.loads(revision.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(revision_result["revision"], 2)
        self.assertNotEqual(revision_result["body_snapshot_sha256"], result["body_snapshot_sha256"])
        rolled_revision = invoke("reference", "rollback", "--out", str(output), "--reference", revision_result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(rolled_revision.returncode, 0, rolled_revision.stderr)

        duplicate = self._static_ingest(
            output,
            snapshot,
            title="同内容不同地址资料",
            final_url="https://mirror.example.test/article",
        )
        self.assertEqual(duplicate.returncode, 4, duplicate.stderr)
        duplicate_result = json.loads(duplicate.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(duplicate_result["duplicate_content_of"], result["reference_id"])
        rolled_duplicate = invoke("reference", "rollback", "--out", str(output), "--reference", duplicate_result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(rolled_duplicate.returncode, 0, rolled_duplicate.stderr)

        body_snapshot = Path(result["extraction"]["body_snapshot"])
        baseline_body = body_snapshot.read_bytes()
        body_snapshot.write_bytes(baseline_body + b"drift")
        drift_audit = invoke("reference", "audit", "--out", str(output))
        self.assertEqual(drift_audit.returncode, 5)
        self.assertIn("reference-web-body-drift", drift_audit.stdout)
        body_snapshot.write_bytes(baseline_body)
        repaired_audit = invoke("reference", "audit", "--out", str(output))
        self.assertEqual(repaired_audit.returncode, 0, repaired_audit.stderr)

        rolled = invoke("reference", "rollback", "--out", str(output), "--reference", result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(rolled.returncode, 0, rolled.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(human.exists())
